programme.title: La nouvelle musique
programme.desc: Dans un univers semblable au nôtre, il n'existe qu'un seule musique. Appelé “la musique”, cette suite d'accords berce l'humanité depuis des siècles. Pour Tom, bientôt au chômage, cette suite est devenue insupportable.

programme.title: À cheval dans une maison vide
programme.desc: Au cours d'un voyage d'une journée, un adulte et un adolescent vont voir leur vie durablement modifiée. L'un est un éducateur spécialisé, l'autre est un adolescent sortant juste de prison.

programme.title: Chronique panoramique
programme.desc: Tous ces gens silencieux dans le train, qui sont-ils vraiment et à quoi peuvent-ils bien réfléchir en ce moment même ?

programme.title: Marche forcée
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'une classe verte dans les Cévennes, Lucas, professeur de français dans un lycée de banlieue, surprend deux de ses élèves, Samia et Djome, à l'écart en train de fumer de l'herbe mais bientôt le trio se perd dans le paysage de rivières et de forêts sauvages...

Après un séisme, un homme se réveille emprisonné dans les décombres. Lorsque tout espoir semble perdu, il découvre qu'il n'est pas seul, une autre personne est prisonnière. Ensemble, ils vont tenter de survivre à cette situation désespérée.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Ena, femme pompière passionnée, est très investie dans son métier. Sa fascination pour le feu l'épanouie autant qu'elle impacte sur sa vie familiale.

programme.title: Mémo
programme.desc: Louis, retraité, veut à tout prix garder son indépendance face à la surprotection de sa fille Nina.

programme.title: J'aime beaucoup ta mère
programme.desc: Stéphane, quarante ans, une ancienne petite terreur du collège rend visite à sa mère. Celle-ci doit lui présenter son nouveau compagnon : Martin Mollard, sa tête de turc du collège….

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Ni vu ni connu
programme.desc: Embauché par une femme qui se pense trompée, pour kidnapper et corriger la maîtresse de son mari, un escroc à la petite semaine met au point avec une de ses connaissances une combine pour empocher facilement l'argent. Mais le jour de la confrontation, les choses prennent un tour inattendu.

programme.title: Il faut qu'on parle
programme.desc: Nous avons tous quitté un jour, un(e) conjoint(e) sans raisons valables, si ce n'est l'envie de passer à autre chose. Et bien c'est ce que va faire le personnage d'Adam. Mais l'annonce de sa décision ne va pas se passer comme prévue…

programme.title: Où elle est maman ?
programme.desc: Roberto, Pablo et Sacha sont trois frères. Il y a quelques jours ils viennent de perdre leur maman. Leur papa, Joseph, semble ne pas se préoccuper de la situation. Pour lui, son épouse est encore là. C'est dans cet étrange contexte que les trois hommes vont devoir accompagner leur père dans cet instant difficile, de la marche funèbre à cette nuit où il va disparaître.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: L'Ascension D'un Homme De Main
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Carlton Leach jeune hooligan Anglais qui intègre un des gangs les plus connus du pays à la fin des années 80. Il grimpe alors les échelons au point de devenir le criminel le plus respecté mais aussi détesté. Il devra faire face à ses propres démons lors de cette montée en puissance vers le grand banditisme et tout faire pour éviter la prison.

programme.title: Hwayi: A Monster Boy
programme.desc: Hwayi est un garçon qui vit dans un village agricole. Il a été élevé par cinq pères, tous des criminels notoires. Un jour, le groupe reçoit l'ordre d'assassiner un homme nommé Lim et sa femme.

programme.title: Stormageddon
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un programme informatique, Echelon, prend le contrôle des systèmes informatiques américains, il devient capable de manipuler la météo. Deux robots, Adam et Cain, se battent pour prendre le contrôle d'Echelon avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Take Back
programme.desc: Zara et Brian vivent une vie parfaite dans une petite ville quand un mystérieux inconnu du passé de Zara kidnappe leur fille. Une course contre la montre commence pour la sauver.

programme.title: Being Light
programme.desc: Après LOVERS et TOO MUCH FLESH, le troisième volet de la trilogie sur la liberté. L'amitié entre deux hommes que tout sépare et qui décident de tout lâcher. Ils tentent de se libérer de leurs contraintes sociales, professionnelles et culturelles.

programme.title: Tempting fate
programme.desc: Un chirurgien cérébral a perdu sa chance d'être avec la femme de ses rêves et opte pour l'invention d'un ami qui le transporte dans un monde parallèle, où la femme de ses rêves est « sa » veuve.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: Bunker Palace Hotel
programme.desc: En cette fin de siècle, la guerre règne. L'ex-nomenklatura d'un régime miné par la guérilla s'est retranchée dans un bunker transformé en palace. Tous tentent de survivre en attendant l'arrivée du Président qui doit leur donner de nouvelles directives. Mais Clara, une rebelle, arrive, grâce à un faux laisser-passer à s'introduire dans la cité secrète. Peu à peu, tous les notables s'autodétruisent.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Un procureur voit sa vie basculer lorsqu'il est impliqué dans un délit de fuite et qu'un autre homme est arrêté pour son crime et accusé de meurtre.

programme.title: Les Nettoyeurs
programme.desc: Une équipe de nettoyeurs de scène de crime découvre une mallette remplie d'argent liquide. Le duo va alors être poursuivi par un patron du crime impitoyable, des tueurs à gages et des agents du gouvernement corrompus qui sont prêts à tout pour récupérer l'argent.

programme.title: Virgin secrets
programme.desc: Ronnie a tout du jeune homme parfait : il est séduisant, issu d'une famille aisée, et il s'apprête à rejoindre une prestigieuse université. Mais par-dessus tout, il accompagne la fille la plus en vue du lycée, Mélissa, au bal de fin d'année.

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Julia Roberts, lauréate d'un Oscar, brille dans ce film au casting étourdissant : Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal et l'oscarisée Marcia Gay Harden.

programme.title: Storm Boy
programme.desc: Storm Boy a bien grandi pour devenir un retraité respecté au caractère bien trempé. Son quotidien est brusquement perturbé par des images tirées de son passé qu'il n'arrive pas à décrypter. Une conversation avec sa petite fille le replonge dans une enfance qu'il pensait enfouie à tout jamais.

programme.title: Une affaire de coeur
programme.desc: Audrey Woods et Daniel Rafferty, deux avocats réputés en droit du divorce ont vu au fil des procès l'amour tourner au vinaigre. Pourrait-il en être autrement pour eux ? Au sommet de leur carrière, tout les oppose. Audrey pratique le droit en suivant les règles à la lettre, alors que Daniel se permet tous les coups possibles et inimaginables pour gagner. Bientôt, ils s'affrontent lors d'un méchant divorce public entre des clients célèbres dont le point de discorde est un château en Irlande.

programme.title: Paper Heart
programme.desc: Charlyne Yi se lance dans une quête pour réaliser un documentaire sur le seul sujet qu'elle ne comprend pas: l'amour. Quand elle rencontre un garçon selon son propre cœur (Michael Cera), les choses deviennent intéressantes.

programme.title: How to Be a Latin Lover
programme.desc: Eugenio Derbez (NI REPRIS, NI ÉCHANGÉ) est l'acteur principal de cette comédie furieusement drôle au casting de rêve ! Lorsque Maximo, le séducteur latin vieillissant (Derbez), se fait plaquer par la femme d'âge mûr qu'il a épousée pour son argent, il emménage chez sa sœur Sara (Salma Hayek), à qui il ne parlait plus, et Hugo, son fils de dix ans.

programme.title: Une affaire de coeur
programme.desc: Audrey Woods et Daniel Rafferty, deux avocats réputés en droit du divorce ont vu au fil des procès l'amour tourner au vinaigre. Pourrait-il en être autrement pour eux ? Au sommet de leur carrière, tout les oppose. Audrey pratique le droit en suivant les règles à la lettre, alors que Daniel se permet tous les coups possibles et inimaginables pour gagner. Bientôt, ils s'affrontent lors d'un méchant divorce public entre des clients célèbres dont le point de discorde est un château en Irlande.

programme.title: The Toll
programme.desc: Un thriller sombre et comique sur un opérateur de péage solitaire avec un passé qui le rattrape rapidement.

programme.title: Beyond Lies
programme.desc: En manque d'inspiration pour son prochain roman, Stephen Elliott s'intéresse de près au procès d'un meurtrier, dont il remet en cause la culpabilité. Il décide de mener sa propre enquête, au risque de faire ressurgir son passé sur lequel il avait pourtant tiré un trait. Son obsession pour la vérité dépasse rapidement l'enquête et le confronte à ses propres doutes, sur son père notamment qui l'a abandonné et qu'il n'a jamais pardonné.

programme.title: Burn
programme.desc: Melinda, jeune employée d'une station service, est fatiguée de vivre dans l'ombre de Sheila. Quand le jeune Billy vient braquer l'établissement, Melinda profite de l'occasion pour se mettre du côté de l'agresseur et inverser le rapport de force.

programme.title: Rendez-vous meurtrier
programme.desc: Lorsque Stacy apprend que sa sœur a été victime d'un meurtre près de Sarasota, elle en est dévastée. Suivant les indices, la jeune femme s'approche du tueur, mais ce n'est qu'une question de temps avant qu'il ne frappe à nouveau...

programme.title: Suicide Tourist
programme.desc: Max, détective pour une assurance, apprend qu'il est condamné par une tumeur. Enquêtant sur un homme disparu, il arrive à l'hôtel Aurora, lieu isolé où l'on accompagne les suicides. Hanté par sa propre fin, il découvre un univers troublant.

programme.title: Le merveilleux jardin secret de Bella Brown
programme.desc: Bella, jeune femme fantasque, risque l'expulsion si elle ne remet pas son jardin en état. Elle fait alors la rencontre d'Alfie, son voisin bougon et passionné de jardinage, qui va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: Hungry Hearts
programme.desc: Jude est Américain, Mina Italienne. Ils se rencontrent à New York, tombent fous amoureux et se marient. Lorsque Mina tombe enceinte, une nouvelle vie s'offre à eux. Mais l'arrivée du bébé bouleverse leur relation.

programme.title: Sexy Therapy
programme.desc: L'histoire de Nathan Fisher, la trentaine, écrivain vivant à Brooklyn et dont la carrière est au point mort. Sa petite amie vient de le quitter et il apprend que son père est hospitalisé. Il décide alors de retourner en Floride pour s'occuper de sa famille.

programme.title: Sexy movie
programme.desc: Romantique absolue, Julia Jones a toujours cru au Grand Amour. Lorsqu'elle rencontre enfin l'Homme De Sa Vie, le très british Grant Funkyerdoder, elle croit tenir le bon bout. Mais c'est sans compter sur le retour d' Andy, l'ex de Grant, une vraie bombe sexuelle...

programme.title: Good Advice
programme.desc: Ryan Turner est un jeune banquier-investisseur qui connaît un succès incomparable. Ryan court beaucoup trop les jupons et couche régulièrement avec ses clientes, y compris, malheureusement pour lui, Veronica Simpson, la femme de son plus important client, Donald Simpson.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: L'histoire d'un livre perdu depuis longtemps qui réapparaît mystérieusement et relie un vieil homme à la recherche de son fils à une jeune fille cherchant un remède à la solitude de sa mère.

programme.title: Amoureux pour le Show
programme.desc: Suit l'histoire de Tara Thompson, dont la carrière de présentatrice commence à stagner. Elle accepte de participer à une émission télévisée pour épouser son partenaire idéal , Joe, un homme qu'elle n'a jamais rencontré. Mais en secret, elle tente de le retrouver pour clarifier que le mariage n'est que pour...

programme.title: Taj mahal
programme.desc: À 18 ans, Louise loge avec sa famille dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace. Un soir, restée seule dans sa chambre, elle entend des bruits étranges dans les couloirs de l'hôtel. Elle comprend au bout de quelques minutes qu'il s'agit d'une attaque terroriste.

programme.title: L'envie
programme.desc: Deux voisins, également très bons amis, voient leurs relations se détériorer, lorsque l'un d'entre eux devient riche en commercialisant son invention. L'autre va alors envier sa fortune.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: Walt Disney surmonte les obstacles de son enfance, créant Mickey Mouse et un empire légendaire.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: la Russie contemporaine. Nadya abandonne son rêve lorsqu'elle est hospitalisée pour une blessure.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: Par Amour
programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sous les flocons
programme.desc: Une photographe en quête d'un rare flocon de neige à douze côtés embarque avec une amie d'enfance dans une aventure hivernale qui pourrait transformer leur vie.

programme.title: Un amour de photographe
programme.desc: Laura, assistante de galerie passionnée de photo, doit convaincre Shane, un artiste retiré du monde depuis dix ans, d'exposer ses clichés. En l'aidant à retrouver l'inspiration, elle pourrait aussi trouver sa propre voie.

programme.title: La Demande En Mariage
programme.desc: Une fausse demande en mariage entre Millie et Leo devient virale sur Internet. En jouant les fiancés parfaits pour profiter de leur célébrité soudaine, ils commencent à éprouver de vrais sentiments.

programme.title: À la recherche du bonheur
programme.desc: Amy, journaliste ambitieuse, enquête sur Paul, gourou du bien-être au mode de vie inspirant. Lorsqu'elle découvre son secret, elle doit choisir entre le scoop de sa carrière ou protéger l'homme qu'elle admire.

programme.title: Flirt et passe-passe
programme.desc: Lors d'un séjour à Trinité-et-Tobago, deux jumelles identiques sont prises l'une pour l'autre par leurs prétendants respectifs. En jouant le jeu, elles découvrent que l'amour pourrait les mener là où elles ne l'attendaient pas.

programme.title: Major League: Back To The Minors
programme.desc: A la veille de sa retraite, le lanceur de baseball Gus Cantrell se voit offrir une dernière chance : entraîner les South Carolina Buzz, une équipe de ligue mineure. Malgré la difficulté et des joueurs médiocres, leur propriétaire Roger Dorn est convaincu que Cantrell peut en faire une équipe gagnante.

programme.title: Garde Rapprochee
programme.desc: Sharp, un Texas Ranger habitué des dossiers sensibles, doit protéger les seuls témoins du meurtre de son indic : cinq pom-pom girls, incontrôlables et survoltées ! Il pensait avoir tout vu. Il va vite déchanter.

programme.title: Nuits Blanches A Seattle
programme.desc: Une journaliste fleur bleue entend la voix d'un homme solitaire dans une émission de radio, et c'est le début d'une grande histoire d'amour compliquée à souhait.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: L'histoire de Matilda, jeune prodige, flanquée de parents abrutis et d'une directrice d'école terroriste, qui s'épanouira grâce à son institutrice.

programme.title: Women In Trouble
programme.desc: Un jour dans la vie de 10 femmes à priori très différentes : une star du porno, une hôtesse de l'air, une psychiatre, une masseuse, une serveuse, deux call-girls, etc. Toutes ont un point commun : l'ennui.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: L'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner et son beau-fils Trent s'infiltrent dans une école d'arts du spectacle pour filles après que Trent ait été témoin d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Black/White
programme.desc: Theresa ramène son fiancé Simon Green à la maison, pour le 25e anniversaire de mariage de ses parents, mais elle a oublié de mentionner un détail : il est blanc. Bien déterminé à mettre fin aux fiançailles de sa fille, Percy Jones va prouver qu'un père n'a pas toujours raison.

programme.title: Détestables Nous
programme.desc: Trois amis d'enfance organisent un complot afin de trouver une copine pour Barry, leur ami d'enfance insupportable, vulgaire et désagréable. Leur plan se retourne contre eux quand sa nouvelle petite amie se révèle tout aussi détestable que lui.

programme.title: Femmes hors-la-loi
programme.desc: Une Femme hors-la-loi oblige un jeune médecin à se rendre dans une ville dirigée par des femmes, dont l'indépendance est menacée par un gang criminel.

programme.title: Quatre étranges cavaliers
programme.desc: Dans Silver Lode, Dan Ballard est arrêté par quatre marshals pour meurtre et vol, mais il nie les accusations et cherche le vrai coupable.

programme.title: Custer, l'homme de l'Ouest
programme.desc: L'amour de George Armstrong Custer pour les traditions héroïques du calvaire et son dégoût pour l'arrivée de l'industrialisation le conduisent à son destin à Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Texas, adios
programme.desc: Un shérif texan et son jeune frère traversent la frontière mexicaine pour affronter l'homme qui a tué leur père.

programme.title: Compilation Bonanza Épisodes 47, 48, 49
programme.desc: Les aventures de Ben Cartwright et de ses fils dans le Far West, alors qu'ils gèrent et défendent leur ranch du Nevada tout en aidant la communauté environnante.

programme.title: Pour Django les salauds ont un prix
programme.desc: La fiancée de Django a été enlevée. Il doit donc la délivrer mais ce n'est pas facile. Le problème, c'est que les ravisseurs sont les frères Cortez et leur bande. Ils ont dévalisé une banque et se sont cachés dans une grotte. Django les poursuit avec l'aide d'un Américain et de Fulton. Fulton est un agent chargé de ramener l'or à la banque.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jacob Darien conduit sa famille de quakers à travers Virginia City. Lorsqu'il est accosté par des brutes de la ville, Adam Cartwright intervient avec l'aide de son nouveau compagnon de route, Sam Bord. Adam propose d'escorter le train de chariots à travers le Ponderosa, sans savoir que Sam prépare un vol.

programme.title: Une longue file de croix
programme.desc: Django et Santana sont des chasseurs de primes qui éliminent les bandits dans une petite ville de l'Ouest. Un propriétaire foncier malfaisant qui fait passer clandestinement des immigrants illégaux et les hommes qui travaillent pour lui ont une prime très élevée sur leur tête. Il est donc logique que Django et Santana viennent bientôt leur rendre visite.

programme.title: Un dollar entre les dents
programme.desc: Un pistolero solitaire tente de conclure un marché avec un bandit mexicain pour se partager un chargement d'or volé, ce qui donne lieu à un jeu de trahisons sans merci entre les deux hommes.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: The Moon
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, La Corée, meurtrie par le désastre de sa première mission spatiale, se décide à se lancer de nouveau à la conquête de la lune. Mais un fort vent solaire va laisser un des astronautes, seul, piégé dans l'espace.

programme.title: Le Tourbillon De Couleurs
programme.desc: Après plusieurs années à se cacher, une jeune femme est contrainte à la cavale une fois que ses super pouvoirs sont révélés au grand jour. Des années après avoir abandonné sa famille, elle n'a pas d'autre choix que de rentrer à la maison.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: Des expériences gouvernementales top secrètes sur le voyage dans le temps ont été arrêtées et jugées trop dangereuses pour continuer. Le scientifique principal a disparu avec la technologie et une chasse à l'homme est lancée par le gouvernement.

programme.title: Orcs Wars
programme.desc: Une armée d'Orcs est envoyée dans notre monde pour l'envahir. Un ancien militaire est désigné malgré lui comme étant LE tueur d'Orcs et l'unique sauveur de l'humanité. L'affrontement ultime peut commencer.

programme.title: The Last Fortress
programme.desc: Au 18ème siècle, l'Empereur de Russie Pierre le Grand mène une guerre contre les Suédois.

programme.title: Robin des Bois : La Rébellion
programme.desc: Le Shérif de Nottingham et son cousin Guy de Gisbourne ont à charge de faire respecter la loi et de renforcer l'autorité.

programme.title: La Légende des Mondes
programme.desc: Dans une contrée aujourd'hui disparue, les derniers des Hobbits vivent dans un petit village.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Northmen
programme.desc: Des femmes en quête de vengeance affrontent des Vikings et une armée de démons dans un monastère.

programme.title: Sword Master
programme.desc: L'affrontement entre deux maîtres assassins au service d'un seigneur impitoyable.

programme.title: Planet Dune
programme.desc: Sur la planète Dune, une mission de sauvetage se transforme en carnage face aux vers géants.

programme.desc: Vingt ans après, un homme revient dans la ville où son frère a été tué par un requin. Bientôt le prédateur refait surface et tue à nouveau, l'homme décide de le traquer pour l'arrêter une fois pour toutes.

programme.title: Monster Hunters
programme.desc: Une branche secrète du gouvernement tente d'arrêter une invasion extraterrestre.

programme.title: Les Dieux des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une équipe de sous-marins entre dans une ouverture mystérieuse au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent un ancien peuple venu d'un autre monde.

programme.title: The Signal
programme.desc: Trois étudiants tentent de trouver un pirate rival dans le désert.

programme.title: Lidice
programme.desc: En 1942 à Prague, un officier SS est victime d'un attentat organisé par la Résistance.

programme.title: Haute couture
programme.desc: Avec sa machine à coudre, une australienne transforme les femmes et exerce une douce vengeance.

programme.title: Manglehorn
programme.desc: Manglehorn, serrurier endeuillé par son passé, tente de reconstruire sa vie avec un nouvel ami.

programme.desc: Le 18 juillet 1969, le sénateur Ted Kennedy conduit sa voiture en bas d'un pont sur l'île Chappaquiddick du Massachusetts. L'accident entraîne la mort de Mary Jo Kopechne, une stratège de campagne de 28 ans qui travaillait pour Kennedy.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Un procureur voit sa vie basculer lorsqu'il est impliqué dans un délit de fuite et qu'un autre homme est arrêté pour son crime et accusé de meurtre.

Pendant le tournage, Chet tombe éperdument amoureux de Jane, sa partenaire afro-américaine.

programme.title: Touchback
programme.desc: Scott Murphy (Brian Presley), un agriculteur en difficulté, réfléchit à ses rêves brisés après qu'une blessure au football en 1996 ait mis fin à sa chance de devenir une légende. Un accident le transporte à la semaine précédant le match de championnat, lui offrant une chance de changer son destin.

programme.desc: Dee, artiste de rue, Marcus, voleur : deux frères pour qui être antisocial est un mode de vie.

programme.title: Mad Dog
programme.desc: Deux adolescents sont portés disparus après une rave party dans un lieu secret...

programme.desc: Luke Vaughn (Jeffrey Dean Morgan), un père désespéré, braque le casino du chef de la mafia Pope Silva (Robert De Niro) pour sauver sa fille malade. Le braquage tourne mal, obligeant Vaughn et son équipe à détourner un bus pour s'échapper.

programme.desc: Angelo ne vit que pour la boxe thaï. Ecarté injustement des championnat, il tue accidentellement le challenger dans un combat de rue. A sa sortie après six ans de prison, c'est une épave.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Brian Cox On Finding Purpose In A Vast Universe
programme.desc: What can the universe teach us about being human? Physicist Professor Brian Cox discusses getting comfortable with being wrong, the difference between having an argument and making an argument, and how curiosity and doubt are essential to learning and happiness. He explores why ego blocks human progress, how democracy depends on doubt, the beauty of curiosity, the randomness of life, and our greatest moral responsibility in protecting the planet.

programme.title: Leah Williamson On Bouncing Back From A Footballer's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Footballer Leah Williamson discusses how getting through a major injury has made her love the person she is now more than the one she was before because of the way she looks after herself. Leah talks about the importance of listening to your own body, and trusting what it's trying to tell you rather than ignoring or overriding it.

programme.title: How Coleen And Wayne Rooney Make Their Marriage Work
programme.desc: Coleen Rooney discusses how she and husband Wayne prioritise honesty, family and their relationship after many years together. She explains how she's instilling honesty in her four sons and the importance of having a village to help raise her boys. Coleen also discusses school gate WhatsApp group dynamics, dealing with stress, and what it was like being thrust into the public eye as a teenager when her boyfriend became a footballer.

programme.title: Little People, Big Day
programme.desc: Mark Trombino and Carol Skladany, both of whom are described as “a little couple,” have faced unique challenges due to their height. Mark, who stands at 3 feet 3 inches tall, has adapted to the world around him by using extended pedals in his car, a booster seat, and seeking assistance at gas stations. Carol, at 3 feet 11 inches, had never had a serious boyfriend until age 41 and had given up on her lifelong dream of marriage and motherhood. Despite their individual struggles, they found love with each other, and their journey is documented in the context of preparing for their big day.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners
programme.desc: On an episode of “The Wedding Planners,” two different planners work with brides in different locations to plan their special weddings. Melissa Barrad in Southern California assists Rosie and Nandi in planning their wedding at a golf course overlooking the Pacific Ocean. They focus on details like choosing the best location for sunset photos and selecting floral arrangements. Tammy Cowart, on the opposite coast in Orlando, Florida, deals with Jill and Jack. She faces challenges such as hurricane force winds on the wedding day and a venue that requires significant improvements.

programme.title: Bling on the Bride
programme.desc: We are introduced to four planners from Austin, Texas, who collaborate to infuse their unique Texas style into every wedding they organize. Additionally, a planner from Southern California is passionate about creating dream weddings. Austin Planners:Kathie, Vivian, Jeff, and Kiley aim to transform a lakeside yacht club in Texas into a Moroccan beach resort for their couple, Lynsey and Seth. Since the bride and groom reside in Los Angeles, the planners must make decisions on color palettes, floral arrangements, and lounge furniture without direct input. Just hours before the wedding day, a hailstorm unexpectedly hits the lakeside location, adding to the challenges. Southern California Planner (Melissa Barrad): Melissa organizes an elegant wedding at a historical site in San Diego for her couple, Will and Kasey. Her primary concern is transitioning the formal ceremony setting into Kasey's envisioned reception ballroom within a tight timeframe. Despite the unusually chilly California night, the guests patiently await the celebration.

programme.title: Sin City Weddings
programme.desc: Las Vegas, known for its neon-lit allure, attracts over 100,000 couples annually who choose to tie the knot in this vibrant city. Whether eloping or planning a destination wedding, Las Vegas offers a range of options. Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. And for a truly iconic experience, they can even get married by the legendary Elvis Presley himself. From bustling marriage bureaus to gilded chapels, Las Vegas provides a unique and unforgettable wedding experience.

programme.title: April in Paris Bride
programme.desc: Wedding cake is important to every bride. But wedding planner David Tutera knows it has a deeper meaning to bride Kristina, who has struggled with an eating disorder. Kristina's fiancé wouldn't marry her until she was able to eat and enjoy the cake at their wedding. Now that Kristina is healthy, it's time to plan her April in Paris wedding. Trouble is, Kristina has everything from the Eiffel Tower to French poodles thrown into the mix! The bridesmaids chose their own dresses, and the reception venue is a hot tub resort an hour away. David creates a flower-filled fantasy of Parisian art and entertainment. Let them eat cake!

programme.title: Hawaiian Luau Bride
programme.desc: Bride Kristin went from a size 24 to a size 6 after having a stroke. Her fiancé stayed by her side through it all, and even lost 50 pounds himself! Now, Kristin wants her wedding to feel like she's at a Hawaiian luau. But her theme has become as tacky as a tiki torch. The flowers are fake, the bridesmaids are barefoot, and her backyard venue is hardly Hawaiian. Wedding planner David Tutera decides to show off his bride's new figure and her sweet nature, too. With fabulous fashion, flowers, and fire dancers David turns this bride's wedding into a real tropical dream.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E11
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America's National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.sub-title: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: The Grim Escape

programme.desc: So the final puzzle forces ninja to question the true meaning of the Green Ninja Prophecy. Solving the puzzles releases a new peril for the Ninja to face. Will memories of their greatest victories be enough to defeat it?

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Celebrating The Special Day

programme.title: Only One Can Remain
programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff.
